summary: A +2 heavy crossbow with Lightning Arrow and Reposition Malefactor.

fields.Lightning Arrow: Action once per Long Rest, range 60 ft. Cast at level 4. Make a ranged spell attack for 5d8 Lightning on the primary target. The separate 10 ft-radius burst occurs even on a miss for 3d8 Lightning, halved on a Dexterity save against your spell save DC. The linked source reports that failing the initial Dexterity save guarantees the primary hit.
fields.Reposition Malefactor: Action at weapon range with no cooldown. Deals half weapon damage and pulls the target 30 ft toward you on a failed DC 15 Dexterity save. There is no attack roll, so it does not count toward Extra Attack or attack-roll-dependent damage riders.
fields.Crafting: Combine Watcher Crossbow Blueprint, Targeting Module and Steel Watcher Arm at the Security Office workbench in the Steel Watch Foundry.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
